intro: Even with three photos, a picture is emerging: you seem to enjoy walkable Iberian cities with food, architecture, and an easy route to the water.

suggestions.reason: Valencia combines the Spanish city life of Barcelona with an inviting Mediterranean shoreline.
Athens adds layered history and a lively Mediterranean setting to your Lisbon, Porto, and Barcelona trail.
Copenhagen keeps the compact, walkable city feel while adding a cooler waterfront mood to your Iberian stops.
